text:
Maya Li: Heads up — NLB in us-west-2 edge pool dropped ~42 targets between 08:10-08:14 UTC. CloudWatch shows a spike in TCP healthcheck RSTs.

Omar Khan: Saw the alert, same. TargetGroup: tg-0a1b2c3d. Any recent node work?

Leah Park: We kicked off automated node reprovision for a subset of GPU nodes at 08:08 to swap image. That job restarts kube-proxy/kubelet briefly.

Raj Patel: That fits. Our NLB does TCP healthchecks against nodePort. If kube-proxy tears down iptables rules before pod readiness flips, HB packets land on closed port -> RST -> target marked unhealthy fast.

infra-bot: alert: 42 targets deregistered from arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456:targetgroup/tg-0a1b2c3d (event at 2026-03-12T08:13:12Z)

Maya Li: paste of `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:...` result (trimmed):
```
{"TargetHealthDescriptions":[{"Target":{"Id":"10.0.5.23","Port":30080},"TargetHealth":{"State":"unhealthy","Reason":"Target.ConnectionError","Description":"Connection reset by peer"}}]}
```

Omar Khan: quick mitigation options: pause the reprovision job, bump deregistration_delay on the TG, or shift healthcheck to the pod IPs (targetType=ip) to avoid nodePort race.

Leah Park: we should also consider increasing healthcheck interval/threshold during rollouts so transient restarts don't cause mass deregisters.

Raj Patel: Agreed. For immediate fix I set `deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds=300` and bumped healthcheck interval to 10s + healthy threshold 3. Also paused the reprovision job.

infra-bot: change: target-group attribute update applied by Omar Khan (iam-role) at 2026-03-12T08:22:05Z

Maya Li: after changes we saw targets slowly re-register over ~4 minutes. No more RST spikes.

Omar Khan: Follow-ups: (1) modify reprovision job to `drain` nodes before restarting kube-proxy (2) add pre-hook to pause autoscaler during image rolling for edge pools (3) long-term: evaluate `targetType=ip` for edge NLBs to avoid nodePort fragility.

Leah Park: I'll make a postmortem ticket and add recommended terraform change for `deregistration_delay` as a stopgap.

Raj Patel: Also adding a monitor to alert if >10% of a TG gets deregistered in 5m outside maintenance windows.

Maya Li: thanks all — closing thread once postmortem link is in. :thumbsup:
